name: Sanction Scanner
description:
SanctionScanner MCP brings AML compliance capabilities directly into Claude. Compliance officers can screen individuals and companies against global sanctions lists, PEP databases, and adverse media sources through natural language — no need to switch between tools.

Key capabilities:

Sanctions & PEP screening — Screen names against 1,000+ global watchlists with fuzzy matching
Adverse media — Search news across financial crime, terrorism, regulatory, and other risk categories
Case management — Add memos, set risk levels, assign cases, enable ongoing monitoring
Compliance reporting — Get workload snapshots, alert summaries, and compliance statistics
Customer risk — Query KYC risk scores and high-risk customer lists (requires CRA product)
KYB — Search and retrieve company profiles (requires KYB product)
Authentication uses your existing SanctionScanner API credentials. All actions are scoped to your organization and logged in your SanctionScanner activity log.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sanction Scanner to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sanction Scanner to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sanctionscanner.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sanction Scanner MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sanction Scanner lists 30 MCP tools, including add_case_memo, add_tag, assign_scan_to_user, close_case, enable_monitoring, get_adverse_media_detail, get_adverse_media_stats, get_company_details, get_compliance_stats, get_customer, get_customer_risk_score, and get_monitoring_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sanction Scanner?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sanction Scanner in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.

_published_faq.name: Does Sanction Scanner MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sanction Scanner requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sanction Scanner is developed by Sanction Scanner. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
